  catalog record is I7-C2 — Deviation 1).

- R4 (Leg B — held): activation on the seeded hosts is the operator's

- R5 (SIG-LIC-004a / SIG-TRANSP-004): the page family's terms captured

| planned | landed |
|---|---|
| The connector — public unauthenticated pages, bounded | `DocumentCloudConnector` (name `documentcloud`, v1.0.0): discover walks the committed inventory only; fetch = one polite GET through `ctx.fetcher` (opt-out → politeness → interstitial → kind dispatch → in-memory Part VIII screen → admit); capture persists ONLY the screened records; parse/extract/normalize/link/load pure over the screened artifact; a per-target outcome ledger records served/refused + kind, counts-only |
| The Part VIII screen wiring | every rendition candidate field screens under its declared hazard name (`screen_as` map) through `evidence.screen` + the committed `ops/at_rest_audit.toml` declaration + `data/field_denylist.toml` — the auditable screen, never a drifted copy; the whole canonical record re-screens after redaction |
| The redacted rendition + refusal | `sig.documentcloud-rendition/1` (allowlisted fields + `redacted_fields` name+classes+value-sha256 + `refused_fields` names + `uploader_page` + upstream URL + original sha256/bytes) OR `sig.documentcloud-refusal/1` (pointer + classes + counts + hash — the content dropped) |
| Terms capture | `sig.documentcloud-terms/1` — verbatim bounded (≤100 KB) terms text + source URL + capture digest; `terms_page` kind restricted to `^/tos/?$` on `www.muckrock.com` |
| Registry-row appends | `sources.toml [sources.muckrock_public]` — `public_terms_only`, `ingestion_permitted=false`, rights UNDETERMINED/`review_needed` (fail-closed pre-flip); `[sources.documentcloud]` notes updated to name this connector path, gated posture preserved; the `muckrock` api_v2 row untouched |
| Leg-B staging | `docs/build/reports/rights/p3677/leg-b-packet.md` — agent-drafted (OM-09 labelled), go lines blank for the operator |
| Committed inventory | `data/documentcloud_targets.toml` — `sig.documentcloud-targets/1`: derivation provenance block + 11 sorted seeds (`target_count` honest; fail-closed on drift — schema/count/https/public-path/kind) |
| Reviewed vocabulary | `data/documentcloud_vocab.toml` — `sig.documentcloud-vocab/1`: 4-predicate allowlist + forbidden genres; six kinds' public path regexes; committed host set; terms ids; interstitial markers; MuckRock status markers; `screen_as` map |
| Live-target + runner wiring (routable, never run) | `live_targets.toml` `[documentcloud]`/`[muckrock_public]` + `live_targets.py` expansion branch → `documentcloud_targets()`; `runner.py` `CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE` both ids + fixture-run target-resolution set |
| Screen membership | `ops/at_rest_audit.toml`: the new source/connector's lane membership appended (S6 records-derived handling + relevant Part VIII classes) |
| Fixtures + tests | `tests/connectors/fixtures/documentcloud/` (8 committed fixtures) + `tests/connectors/test_documentcloud.py` — 29 tests, zero network |

## Deviations (recorded, not smoothed)

- **The ticket's `I7-C13` label names no catalog record.** The discovery
  evidence is `decision_catalog.csv` row **I7-C2** plus the I6/I7
  candidate rows (I7-U645/U669/U681, I6-C031) — the inventory's
  `source_ref` records this verbatim rather than citing an invented
  record. If `I7-C13` lives in another lane, reconciling it is a
  follow-up.
- **The DocumentCloud source row pre-existed and stays gated.** Its
  notes now name this connector path; the rights posture (UNDETERMINED,
  MuckRock ToS exclusion recorded) is preserved byte-for-byte — the row
  is NOT evidence the family is cleared. `D-SOURCES.2-2` stays OPEN.
- **Persisted artifact = the screened record, never served bytes**
  (ADR-185's strongest read, same as P36.74/P36.76): document binaries
  (pdf/full_text/asset URLs) are pointers only — the rendition lane's
  bound.
- **The `muckrock` api_v2 authenticated row is untouched** — it is the
  `records` connector's own gated lane; the new `muckrock_public` row
  serves the public-page surface only and never touches
  `accounts.muckrock.com` (excluded from the committed host set).
- **The gate counts moved** (`test_review_status.py`): 589 → 590
  registered; loadable 237 and flip-ready 2 unchanged — the comments and
  assertions carry the P36.77 line (OM-15 respected: the test asserts the
  seeded-registry invariant shape the file already maintains).
- **Size budget overage (OM-16, recorded):** the ticket sized S ≤1,500
  changed lines excl. generated + fixtures. Actual non-generated,
  non-fixture: ~2,030 implementation+data (connector 1,551 — docstring/
  policy-heavy like P36.76's; targets TOML 160; vocab TOML 129; shared
  wiring ~130) + ~728 tests + ~350 docs (ledger/PR/queue/packet)
  ≈ 3,100. Same posture as P36.74/P36.76's recorded overages — the
  alternative is stripping the refusal-kind and governance commentary
  reviewers need.
- **Two DEFERRALS rows again hit the obligation-tooling deadlock**
  (`obligation_events.py append` validates the whole DEFERRALS↔events
  chain per call): worked around exactly as P36.76 recorded — the second
  row staged aside while its sibling's anchor appended, then restored
  byte-identically (verified: same line number + sha256), its own anchor
  appended, `check` green. A batched-anchor path remains the follow-up.
